name: mesh
label: Mesh Panel
_redirect: Whether this style can carry the sanctioned-app redirect notice. Opt-in per style because the notice is a flat 3347 B and PAN-OS drops an oversize page silently: nyan's URL block page is 15558 B before it, so declaring support there would push the served page past the 17999 B ceiling and the firewall would show its own default instead. Every other style has room.
_note: A masked hairline grid under a glass card, with the brand row outside the card. The quietest of the decorated shells: one disc, no motion beyond it.
